title: Committed design — Case-Author stage-1 node (selection + framing)
description: Headwater Case-Author stage 1 emits this project-level document: what is in-scope for mint, and the teachable shape, stamped derived_from the corpus. It is NOT an atom (no atom_ id, no meaning.source_text, no occurrence intent/expression/audience). Stage 2 mint does not exist in the hop that landed this schema; when it wakes, it wakes on this artifact existing with status validated AND a warrant join that is either a held/validated goal_ or a recorded SOP-course Direct escape — one of those two, not neither. Unreachable-LO terminal (a goal whose trainable slice is empty) means this artifact is NOT validated for mint. Status is proposed until a human validates; the agent never sets validated. Species-closed lists (status, warrant-join kind, escape kind) live here as committed-design.v0.1 — version-bump to extend; do not silently extend beats.catalog proposed/accepted, voice draft/accepted, or goal draft/example/validated. Canonical instances will live per-project; this schema is shared core.

schema_version.description: Closed with this schema. A new status value, escape kind, or join kind is a version bump, not a silent extend.

design_id.description: Opaque id of this design node. Never atom_, never ele_. Minted once; never reused, never edited.

status.description: v0.1 closed list for THIS species. proposed = Headwater Case-Author (or a human) has drafted the selection+framing; validated = a human has ratified it for mint. Reuses the house words (beats start at proposed; the warrant chain ratifies as validated) without extending those other enums. The agent never writes validated.

reviewer.description: Who validated. Required when status is validated; forbidden while proposed. A human handle, never an agent id.

client.description: Client namespace slug (e.g. brunswick). Not a person.

project.description: Project slug (e.g. paytrans). The live design would live under that project; this schema's example is not a live client design.

proposed_by.description: Provenance of the proposal (e.g. headwater.case_author). Not a ratification.

_note.description: Free-text note about this document as a whole — example marker, provenance. House style (goal.schema.json). Never a corpus dump.

inventory_ref.description: A pointer into a client inventory (docs registry, records registry). Refs, never embedded blobs, never atom_ / ele_.

id.description: Governed inventory id. doc_ from docs.registry; rec_ from records.registry. Not atom_, not ele_, not cd_.

registry.description: Which client registry holds this id.

derived_from.description: The corpus this design is derived from. Store path + inventory refs. Never the blobs, never meaning.source_text.

source_store.description: Store-relative pointer to the corpus home (client/project source), never the file bytes.

inventory_refs.description: The inventory entries that constitute the corpus. Refs, not embeddings.

selection.description: What becomes canon vs what stays in the source store. Left-out material is never deleted.

in_scope.description: Inventory items the mint may decompose. Still resident in the source store until minted.

left_in_source_store.description: Remains in the source store. Not deleted. Not minted from this design.

framing.description: The teachable shape — enough for a future mint to know what to decompose. Does not mint goal_ or obj_ (Strategist / Designer). May reference a held goal_ and locked obj_ ids. Never a corpus dump, never PII, never occurrence intent/expression/audience.

shape.description: The bounded teachable object (what this course is), in designer terms. Not source text. Not a syllabus of atoms.

goal_ref.description: Optional pointer at a held goal_ (Strategist). A reference, not a mint.

objective_refs.description: Optional pointers at locked obj_ ids (Designer). References, not a mint.

warrant_join.description: Exactly one of: a held/validated goal_ ref, or a recorded SOP-course Direct escape. Not neither. Unreachable-LO terminal is not a held warrant — the gate rejects status=validated against it. kind / escape_kind are v0.1 closed lists on this species.

kind.description: Open-project door: a human-ratified goal_ whose reachability records that a learning intervention can move the measure.

objective_refs.description: Locked obj_ ids that serve this goal, when Designer has locked them. Optional at stage 1; mint still does not write them.

kind.description: This pile is actually one bounded SOP-course. Takes the Direct door without pretending a warrant was found.

escape_kind.description: v0.1 closed list. sop_course = one bounded SOP/form; the document is the syllabus. Version-bump to extend; do not silently add values.

recorded_by.description: Human who recorded the escape. Agent never writes this.

rationale.description: Why this corpus is one bounded SOP-course, not an open-project dossier.
